geometry_scope: Same supplied pose geometry for all batch stages; caller verifies actual unchanged depth/ID/VALID, n1/n16 identity and true prior-motion blocker binding.

uncertainty.reference_scope: One independently sampled finite 1024-spp image per pose; caller binds actual seeds/counts. It is not a noiseless truth.
uncertainty.pixel_error_sd: Spatial SD of signed pixel-mean RGB errors, not an IID SEM; no statistical significance is inferred from correlated pixels.
uncertainty.adverse_rises: Reported relative to the finite reference; brightness jumps are signed displayed changes at fixed geometry, not physical illumination changes.

pooling: Sum pixel squared errors divided by 3*pixel count, then square root. Reveal/right158 pools only pose15; extra observations remain per_pose. n4/n8/n16 finger progression is measured, not forced monotone.
